status: PROPOSAL (W2 PCB-SB2): board-side contract of IMU_CARRIER; not generated by mechanical/build.py
why: mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json has no IMU_CARRIER entry (mechanical/params/boards.json small_boards IMU_CARRIER points at imu_pack.json carrier_pcb, a 40.28 x 6.0 reserve that cannot hold the 16 W2 GR-4 pads); this file stands in until the IMU lineage adopts the outline in imu_pack.json.
frame: board mm, origin = IMU pack box inside (2.0, 0.5) (mechanical/params/imu_pack.json), axes parallel to the box x/y, y up; the board top (KiCad F, all parts) faces the box lid

sources.board_pair: imu_pack.json boards origin_in_box [1.8, 6.8], pair [40.7, 25.6], standoff_h 13.0, bno_first; Adafruit 4754 BNO085 board 25.4 x 22.86 with four plated D2.5 holes at (2.54, 2.54), (22.86, 2.54), (2.54, 20.32), (22.86, 20.32) (EAGLE Adafruit_BNO08x.brd of github.com/adafruit/Adafruit-BNO08x-PCB at be9dc9984bb19b1e8ba31e8744917d0952993ef2, CC BY-SA, fetch-only, read with lxml 2026-11-11); laid with its 22.86 side along x (pair width 40.7 = 22.7 + 18.0, assumption), so its front standoffs stand at box (4.34, 9.34) and (22.12, 9.34); Waveshare RP2040-Zero: castellated module, no mounting hole on the wiki page (https://www.waveshare.com/wiki/RP2040-Zero read 2026-11-11)
sources.standoffs: Würth 970130155, M2.5 female/female polyamide hex 5.0 AF x 13.00 (DigiKey DE 732-13002-ND, read 2026-11-11; parts DB AI-STANDOFF-IMU-13)
sources.tripod_insert: imu_pack.json tripod c [22.14, 19.64] (1/4-20 x 12.7 brass insert in the carrier under the board pair)

stackup.fab: JLC 2-layer FR-4 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer copper (standard; decision 'Малі плати II: шари й мідь (W2 PCB-SB2)', build/15)

IMU_CARRIER.name: IMU_CARRIER in the Hammond 1550Z101 IMU pack: TVS U552, reverse isolation D502, C519/C520/C340/C341, R390/R391 and the 26 AWG pads J518 (IMU cable), J320/J321 (RP2040-Zero U309), J322 (BNO085 U314)
IMU_CARRIER.outline_note: strip, tongue and arm: the strip x 0-40.28, y 0-5.9 is the imu_pack.json carrier_pcb reserve [2.0, 0.5, 40.28, 6.0] less 0.1 at its top (BNO085 standoff hex 5.0 AF at box (4.34, 9.34) reaches y 6.45); the tongue x 6.0-16.5, y 5.9-11.5 (box x 8.0-18.5) runs under the BNO085 between its two front standoffs (box x <= 7.23 and >= 19.23 with the hex corners) and carries only the BNO085 pull-ups and 3V3 capacitor (no supply current under the magnetometer); the arm x 25.0-40.28, y 5.9-14.5 lies under the RP2040-Zero (box x 24.5-42.5), for which no standoffs are chosen, right of the BNO085 standoffs (box x <= 25.0) and 6.7 from the 1/4-20 insert axis (box (22.14, 19.64)); the 16 wire pads at 4 mm pitch and the 8 parts do not fit the 40.28 x 6.0 strip (W2 GR-4 GR4-R1); OPEN for the mechanical and IMU lineages: the printed carrier model (mechanical/srrx_mech/cad_fixtures.py:112-116, mechanical/generated/stl/imu_carrier.stl) puts four D5.0 x 13 posts at the pair corners, box (4.3, 9.3), (40.0, 9.3), (4.3, 29.9) and (40.0, 29.9); the post at (40.0, 9.3) under the RP2040-Zero corner stands in this arm over the J518 courtyard (RX pad centre 1.39 from its axis) and the U552 courtyard (2.19), and no post stands at the BNO085 front-right hole (22.12, 9.34); the posts move to the BNO085 holes (box x 4.34 / 22.12, y 9.34 / 29.66 under the orientation assumption) or give way to the AI-STANDOFF-IMU-13 standoffs, and the RP2040-Zero fixing clears the arm, else the arm gets a notch, J518 and U552 move and the board is re-routed once ([pcb-route IMU_CARRIER]); drawing I-01 (mechanical/srrx_mech/antennas.py:294) draws the BNO085 with 25.6 along x, while the pair 40.7 = 22.7 + 18 (components/adafruit_bno085_4754_rp2040_zero_metal_p.md:34) lays its 22.7 side along x as this board does; in the I-01 orientation the front-right standoff would stand at (24.66, 9.34) and its hex (to x 27.55) would enter the arm by 0.55
IMU_CARRIER.holes_note: box (6.0, 4.0) and (38.28, 4.0) = mechanical/params/imu_pack.json carrier.screws (M3; build/17 F35, 'на тих самих гвинтах — носійна плата IMU_CARRIER'); the stack through the box floor, the printed carrier and this board is OPEN (mechanical/generated/fastener-stacks.json IMU-CARRIER)
IMU_CARRIER.hole_keepout_note: no copper within 3.0 of the screw axes: an M3 ISO 14580 head dk 5.5 (CNC Kitchen M3 page of the same 3djake listing, snapshot web:3djake-tc-s-m2,5x6 note) + 0.25
IMU_CARRIER.max_component_height_note: mechanical/params/imu_pack.json carrier_pcb parts_h 2.5 (assumption of the IMU lineage); D502 SMA 2.3 is the tallest part
IMU_CARRIER.placements_note: frame of the IMU pack, not of the enclosure: board (0, 0) = box inside (2.0, 0.5) on the printed carrier top (imu_pack.json); no enclosure placement
IMU_CARRIER.mount: on the two M3 carrier screws of the printed IMU carrier (build/17 F35; stack OPEN)

edge_zones.use: J321/J320 (RP2040-Zero leads) and J322 (BNO085 leads) up to the board pair on 13 mm standoffs
J518: the four cores of the IMU cable (HELU 49655) from the SKINTOP gland
